signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.consentTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.
signUp.ageConfirm: I am at least {age} years old.
signUp.noRecoveryWarning: Your notes and highlights are encrypted with your password. If you forget it, only your recovery code can unlock them; we cannot reset it for you.

recoveryCode.title: Save your recovery code
recoveryCode.intro: This code is the only way to get your data back if you forget your password.
recoveryCode.warning: Store it somewhere safe and private. Anyone who has it can recover your account.
recoveryCode.confirmCharacter: To confirm you saved it, type these characters from your code.
recoveryCode.mismatch: Those characters do not match your code. Check it and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
signIn.rememberHint: Only use this on a device you trust.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Enter your email address, your recovery code and a new password.
recover.noCodeTitle: I don't have my recovery code
recover.startOverIntro: Without the code, your synced data cannot be decrypted. You can start over with an empty account.
recover.startOverWarning: Starting over permanently deletes the data stored on the server for this account.
recover.startOver: Email me a link to start over
recover.startOverSent: If an account exists for that address, an email is on its way.

accountPanel.title: Account
accountPanel.opaque: {n} items from a newer version are stored safely but not shown here.
accountPanel.signOutKeep: Sign out and keep my data in this browser
accountPanel.signOutWipe: Sign out and delete my data from this browser
accountPanel.signOutWipeWarning: Your notes, highlights and other data in this browser are deleted. What is already synced stays on your account and returns when you sign in again; anything not yet synced is lost.

privacy.title: Privacy and your data
privacy.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and everything stored on the server. It cannot be undone.
privacy.exportPartial: Both backup buttons download the backup of the data kept in this browser. A full backup that includes your synced data is coming later.

accounts.title: Account & sync
accounts.intro: Sign in to sync your notes and highlights between your devices. Everything is encrypted in this browser before it is sent.
accounts.unavailable: Account sync is not available in this browser.
accounts.signupClosed: This server is not accepting new accounts.
accounts.unverified: Your email address is not verified yet. Check your inbox for the verification link.

newCode.password: Enter your password to create a new recovery code

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: You followed a link from your reset email. Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.warning: Without your recovery code, the synced data on the server cannot be decrypted, so this starts over with an empty account. You will get a new recovery code.

exportPassword.label: Backup password
exportPassword.hint: You will need this password to restore the backup. It is not your account password and cannot be recovered.

notice.verified: Your email address is verified. Thank you.

serverSees.1: Your email address, and when and how often you sync.
serverSees.2: How much encrypted data you store and how many devices you use.
serverSees.3: Nothing else: your notes, highlights and device names are encrypted in this browser before they are sent, so the server cannot read them.

error.invalid_credentials: The email or password is not correct.
error.invalid_recovery_code: That recovery code is not correct.
error.damaged_keys: The stored keys for this account could not be read. Try signing in again.
error.crypto: The stored keys could not be unlocked. Sign in again.
error.bad_request: The request was not accepted. Check what you entered.
error.unauthorized: The email or password is not correct.
error.forbidden: That is not allowed for this account.
error.not_found: The server could not find that.
error.conflict_email: An account with that email address already exists.
error.too_large: That is too large to sync.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.signup_closed: This server is not accepting new accounts.
error.server_error: The sync server had a problem. Try again later.
error.network: The sync server cannot be reached.
error.unavailable: Account sync is not available in this browser right now.

feedback.straightRow: Straight rows of keys are easy to guess.
feedback.keyPattern: Short keyboard patterns are easy to guess.
feedback.simpleRepeat: Repeated characters like "aaa" are easy to guess.
feedback.extendedRepeat: Repeated patterns like "abcabcabc" are easy to guess.
feedback.sequences: Common sequences like "abc" are easy to guess.
feedback.recentYears: Recent years are easy to guess.
feedback.dates: Dates are often easy to guess.
feedback.topTen: This is one of the most used passwords.
feedback.topHundred: This is a very commonly used password.
feedback.common: This is a commonly used password.
feedback.similarToCommon: This is similar to a commonly used password.
feedback.wordByItself: A single word is easy to guess.
feedback.namesByThemselves: Single names or surnames are easy to guess.
feedback.commonNames: Common names and surnames are easy to guess.
feedback.userInputs: Do not use your email address or personal details.
feedback.pwned: This password appeared in a data breach.
feedback.l33t: Predictable substitutions like "@" for "a" do not help much.
feedback.reverseWords: Reversed words are not much harder to guess.
feedback.allUppercase: All capitals is almost as easy to guess as all lower case.
feedback.capitalization: Capitalizing the first letter does not help much.
feedback.dictionary: This is similar to a word that is easy to guess.
feedback.extraWords: Add more words that are less common.
feedback.useWords: Use a few words and avoid common phrases.
feedback.useLonger: Use a longer keyboard pattern with more turns.
feedback.noNeed: You can have a strong password without symbols, numbers or capitals.
feedback.associatedYears: Avoid years that are associated with you.
